title: The Average Traveler Forgets to Pack 3 Things — Survey
paragraphs: You've arrived at your hotel on the first day of your vacation. You just need to give your phone a quick charge before taking your first walk around the city.
But that charge may not be so quick — because you realize you left your phone charger at home!
If this has happened to you, you're not alone. In fact, phone chargers are among the most common items people forget to pack, according to a new survey by Talker Research.
The survey asked 2,000 Americans about how they prepare for a trip.
It found that many people start packing three days before they leave.
Packing early doesn't always mean packing well, though — because the survey also found that, on average, people forget to pack three things!
Toothbrushes and chargers are the most common forgotten items, followed by toiletries and sunglasses.
People also often forget headphones, socks and shoes.
Participants said they've spent an average total of $363 replacing forgotten items.
The survey also asked participants about the day they leave for their trip.
Half said they check their flight status and look for possible delays before leaving home.
On average, they arrive at the airport an hour before their flight leaves if they're flying within their country. They arrive an average of 75 minutes early when flying to another country.
Many people said the first thing they do at the airport is check to make sure their gate "exists." And for about 15%, it's straight to the bar for a drink — even if it's early in the morning!
